messages:
Aisha (AE): Quick ask from Acme POC — they need SOC 2 excerpt + signed pen-test letter, and a short staging IP window for an external vuln scan. Target window: Tue 10am PST next week. Can we support and what's the turnaround?
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can pull SOC2 excerpt + network diagram. For pen-test letter, legal needs a completed template (signer, scope). If they want a signed PDF, legal turnaround ~48h after we submit.
Marco (Sec): Need to confirm we allow external scans on that staging cluster. What type of scan (authenticated vs unauthenticated)? Also we should not include any key material in the scope.
Aisha (AE): Scan is unauthenticated external scan. Acme security lead: alice@acme.com. They asked for one-hour window starting 10:00 PST.
Darren (Eng): We can open the egress/ingress for a pinned IP range for the hour. Provide exact IPs we should whitelist. Also, please confirm UA/IP rate so we don't trigger autoscaling alarms.
Aisha (AE): Sending IPs from Acme: 34.82.120.44, 34.82.120.45.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Copying the SOC2 excerpt link here: https://redwood.docs/compliance/soc2-excerpt-2025.pdf — includes control descriptions and evidence samples.
Marco (Sec): Ok on unauthenticated. We'll redact any references to ephemeral credentials. Also confirm no on-prem components are in scope.
Aisha (AE): Confirmed: only hosted staging endpoints, no KMS or creds in-scope.
Darren (Eng): For firewall change, please give exact CIDR. If they are single IPs use /32. Example we need:
```
34.82.120.44/32
34.82.120.45/32
```
Darren (Eng): Also send the scan user-agent or source ASN so we can whitelist at infra layer.
Aisha (AE): Scan lead said UA is "AcmeScanner/2.1" and source ASN AS15169.
Marco (Sec): Good. I'll log the scan window and set monitoring for rate spikes. Please note we require a signed pen-test letter on company letterhead asserting authorized testing and indemnity — legal will attach our standard addendum.
LegalBot: To proceed with signed pen-test letter, provide the following fields in a reply: signer_name, signer_title, company_name, testing_scope, desired_return_email. We'll generate signed PDF within 48 hours once completed.
Aisha (AE): Filling now — signer_name: Alice Nguyen; signer_title: Head of Security; company_name: Acme Corp; testing_scope: unauthenticated external vuln scan against staging endpoints only; desired_return_email: alice@acme.com
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll bundle SOC2 excerpt + network diagram + suggested parapgraph for the pen-test letter and upload to presigned S3.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Upload prepared — presigned link (expires in 24h): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/acme/scan-package.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400
Marco (Sec): Noted. Security will review the uploaded package and mark any items to redact before legal signs.
Darren (Eng): I'll schedule the firewall change for next Tue 09:55 PST to open the two IPs and close at 11:05 PST. Will add a quick rollback if we see abnormal traffic.
Aisha (AE): Thanks team — timeline looks good. Legal, please confirm when you have the signed PDF and we'll pass to Acme.
LegalBot: Received the filled fields. We'll return signed pen-test letter by EOD (48h window starts now).
Aisha (AE): Awesome — passing to ACME: alice@acme.com. I will update thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
